notes: The input is the bytes of a request body. The route reads it as JSON and gives the object to the entry point.
value is the parsed request, with every default filled in.
refusal.http_status is the HTTP status of the answer. refusal.body is the error body of contract 02 §14, as parsed JSON.
The family, the session and the turn of the path are in context. The entry point does not check them. It copies the family and the session into an error body.
A time in a value is in UTC, in the ISO 8601 form of Python: +00:00 and not Z, and six digits of fraction when the fraction is not zero.
value.delegation is always null. No body carries one.
The service behind the route is a stand-in. A refusal that the real service makes after the parse has no vector here.
